title: W9 surge-lands pin counts pre-window base spawns in the numerator, loosening the ≥0.95×window contract to ~88%
detail: stream_spawned accumulates from tick 1, but MIN_LAND budgets only the 1800-tick window. ~1199 pre-window base spawns (1/tick, ticks 1..1199) offset the numerator: the window itself may land at ~15901 (88.3% of 18000) and still pass the 95% acceptance.
recommended_fix: Count only spawns with tick >= SURGE_START in stream_spawned (and window-scope per_host_spawns or budget it over the full run so numerator and bound match).

title: health_test's re-pinned latency-enter assertion is guarded by win_delivered > 0 with no non-vacuity pin — the enter-metric claim can silently skip
detail: The re-pin's stated contract is 'the re-tuned email enters via LATENCY, not loss', but if email breached with zero window deliveries the assertion silently skips and that claim goes unpinned. The minion applied the delivered>0 precondition pattern in W10 but not here.
recommended_fix: Add testing.expectf(t, s.health.win_delivered[0] > 0, ...) before the guard (the W10 non-vacuity pattern), so a zero-delivery regression fails loudly.

title: node_health growth-born re-pin's cause-chain skips same-tick arrivals (waiting_ticks == 0), leaving a hole in the replacement for the dropped res-stays-green pin
detail: The old absolute 'res stays green' assertion was dropped (documented W6 interplay); its replacement only inspects packets that already waited ≥1 tick at snapshot time, so a just-arrived stuck packet at the connected res evades the dst>=5 cause check.
recommended_fix: Drop the waiting_ticks==0 continue (or snapshot twice, one tick apart) so every stuck packet at the connected res is checked for the growth-born-sink cause.

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
detail: P0 100% (gating/E24/replay/W10 non-vacuous — draws wired to real ids 0,1,2, !replay_error, delivered>0, ≥40 sourced); P1 ~92% (W9 numerator loose); overall ~90%. §1a/N9 ungated is implicitly pinned (sla fixtures spawn above cap); dead-slot stale credit unreachable (E2 rejects terminal demolish).
recommended_fix: Window-scope the W9 counter, pin win_delivered>0 in health_test, close the waiting_ticks==0 hole — all assertion-tightening, no missing test surface.
